name: foundary-craft
description: Foundary Codex craft skills for language- and paradigm-agnostic code-quality standards: structure (where behaviour and responsibility belong) and expression (how behaviour reads inside cohesive code).

interface.shortDescription: Source-backed code-quality standards with structure and expression decisions for Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Foundary craft plugin with a canonical, source-backed code-quality standards reference and a structure skill for deciding where behaviour, data and dependencies belong without unnecessary architecture, and an expression skill for clear functions, names, flow, state, error handling, and comments.
